asr_text: This study offers an early glimpse of a one-dose treatment that builds CD19 CAR T cells inside the body and deeply reduces B cell levels, with B cells beginning to re-emerge at a median of about two months in participants with several difficult diseases. The signal is promising, but a lasting treatment effect still needs to be proven.
